types.cover: the first page: the deck's title, its subtitle and who presents it
types.content: a page that makes one point in words, photos or a sequence
types.data: a page whose point is figures: metrics, a chart or a matrix
types.closing: the last page: the decision, the ask or the next step

cover_typography_hero.description: Pure typography, no photo: the title alone carries the slide at 128px or larger across most of the width, the subtitle and presenter line small beneath it.

cover_dark_minimal.description: Dark background, a large title centered, a little accent color and nothing else.

cover_split_color.description: Two color blocks side by side, 60/40 (about 960px and 640px): the title on the larger block, the subtitle, date or presenter on the other.

cover_full_image_overlay.description: Full-bleed photo background under a dark overlay, the title centered in white, a metadata bar along the bottom.

cover_magazine.description: Magazine-style title taking 60% of the slide, a photo cropped into the rest.

cover_split_image.description: The title on the left half, the hero photo filling the right half edge to edge.

left_text_right_image.description: Image beside text: the text column on the left (about 45% of the width), the photo filling the right part edge to edge, top to bottom.

three_column_cards.description: Three parallel points: three blocks of equal weight side by side across the full width, each a short heading and one or two lines.

hero_big_number.description: A key number: the one figure that carries the page set huge (up to 160px) with what it measures, beside or under the sentence that says why it matters.

two_column_comparison.description: Comparison: two columns side by side, the same kind of rows in each, for two options, before and after, or two groups.

timeline_horizontal.description: Sequence: three to six steps along one horizontal line across the slide, each a date or phase with a short label.

full_image_text_overlay.description: Image with text: the photo fills the slide, a solid or translucent panel carries the title and two or three lines.

kpi_cards_row.description: Metrics: a horizontal row of two to four KPI cards, each a number with its unit and what it measures; one row, one unit, one source.

chart_with_insight.description: A trend, ranking or share: a native chart on the left (about 60% of the width, the full height under the title), the insight on the right: the sentence the chart proves and one or two supporting figures.

two_by_two_grid.description: Comparison or categories: four quadrants of equal size in a 2x2 grid, each a heading and a line, or a 2x2 matrix.

closing_cta.description: The closing title centered, the ask or next step under it, and a contact line taken only from the company profile.

closing_thank_you.description: A full-bleed closing page on the closing background: one short closing line and the presenter.

question.instructions: Choose the layout of each page of a slide deck from what that page holds: its title, its brief and its photos. Match the layout to the shape of the content: three parallel points call for three_column_cards, one key number for hero_big_number, a comparison or categories for two_column_comparison or two_by_two_grid, a sequence for timeline_horizontal, an image with text for left_text_right_image or full_image_text_overlay, metrics for kpi_cards_row, a series of numbers for chart_with_insight. Judge only from the page's title, brief and photos. Do not count points, figures, steps or comparisons the brief does not state, do not choose a layout for variety, and do not choose by the deck's subject alone.
question.page: Page {number} of {count}, a {type} page. Title: {title}. Brief: {brief}. Photos: {photos}.
